headline: SIGN AFTER CHANGES: 1 high-severity non-compete conflict requires change request
nextAction: Karandeep will ask for changes to the contract to resolve the GCC hospitality data analytics non-compete collision.

findings.title: Collides with Al Noor Hospitality Group: GCC hospitality data analytics non-compete
findings.impact: Collides with the Al Noor commitment restricting AI and data analytics services for GCC hotel operations, which remains active until September 2029.

citations.quote: 9.3 Each Party warrants that it has full power and authority to enter into this Agreement

findings.counterPosition: Ask for changes to Annexure B and Clause 4.1 to exclude the three GCC properties (Properties 10, 11, and 12) from the pilot scope, limiting the agreement exclusively to the nine Indian properties, or seek consent from Al Noor Hospitality Group.

waiver.covers: AtliQ providing demand-forecasting services to Seaside Hotels LLC, Muscat, Oman, solely as described in the statement of work between the Supplier and Seaside dated February 2026
waiver.why: The waiver letter dated 10 February 2026 is strictly limited to demand-forecasting services for Seaside Hotels LLC in Muscat under a specific February 2026 SOW, and explicitly excludes any other hospitality business or GCC property.

fine: Correct AtliQ entity: Pvt Ltd for a India counterparty
Parties = invoicing entity: Pvt Ltd throughout
Governing law matches entity: laws of India (Pvt Ltd → Indian law)
Delay penalties capped: Cap 5% of milestone
Liability capped: each Party's total aggregate liability under this Agreement shall not exceed the total fees paid or payable under this Agreement
Liquidated damages match AtliQ standard of 0.5% per week capped at 5% of the milestone fee, exclude client-caused delays, and serve as the sole and exclusive remedy.
Payment terms match the standard 30-day window from receipt of invoice.
Limitation of liability matches standard with a mutual cap equal to total fees paid or payable, with standard carve-outs.
Indemnity provisions are mutual for breach and negligence, and IP infringement indemnity is limited to AtliQ deliverables.
IP terms correctly retain AtliQ's pre-existing IP and assign custom deliverables to the client only upon payment in full.
Termination for convenience provides 30 days notice and guarantees payment for work performed and pro-rata milestone work in progress.
Confidentiality obligations are mutual, standard exceptions apply, and survival is limited to 3 years.
Data protection provisions comply with applicable data protection laws without imposing uncapped liability or missing sub-processor consent requirements.
